abstract_review.method: Sequential reading of all 37 complete catalogue-abstract packets, with truncated response tails fetched separately. This is abstract-level reading, not full manuscript or proof verification.
abstract_review.scope: Public catalogue abstracts and titles; four additional partial manuscript readings are listed separately.

preprints/Polynomial-PEPS-approximation-.note: PEPS existence is not an efficient construction or contraction algorithm. Constants depend on fixed local dimension, interaction norm and global spectral gap. Area-law companion proof is an unreviewed dependency.

preprints/Memory-and-precision-in-noisel.note: One-pass finite-state exact Gaussian regression with M bits, independent rows and the stated angular-error success criterion. Not arbitrary neural-network parameter counts or multi-pass training.

The claimed new range includes arbitrary internally entangled multimode inputs; the one-mode constrained attenuator entropy bound has earlier precedents.
